Sera Lab

Pick an open-weight model and press Run. Sera's specialist agents propose one configuration change at a time, every trial is measured on the GPU, and anything that breaks the latency target or the quality floor is reverted and recorded as such. Attach a GPU first: notebook specs in the app header → RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell. Without one this still runs, on the analytic simulator, and says so.

Environment

No GPU attached. Use the notebook specs button in the app header to attach an RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell, then re-run this cell. Everything below still works on the analytic simulator meanwhile.

Substrate recorded in the ledger: sim (analytic simulator (no GPU attached)). vllm means each row was produced by a real vLLM server on this device, with warm-up requests excluded from the measurement. sim means Sera's analytic model produced them — deterministic, and not a hardware benchmark.
